items.name: title-reveal
items.title: Title Reveal
items.description: Each word rises in turn, then a marker draws under the key word.

items.name: rotating-word
items.title: Rotating Word
items.description: One sentence, one word that keeps changing.

items.name: before-after-text
items.title: Before and After Text
items.description: The old way is crossed out and the new way takes its place.

items.name: chat-flow
items.title: Chat Flow
items.description: From a button to a chat: picks, a sent message, typing dots and a reply.

items.name: question-typer
items.title: Question Typer
items.description: Each question is typed out and its answer appears right under it, changing with every question.

items.name: appointment-reminder
items.title: Appointment Reminder
items.description: A reminder with buttons: the customer taps Confirm and the confirmation comes back.

items.name: payment-notification
items.title: Payment Notification
items.description: A payment lands on the lock screen, the app opens and the amount counts up.

items.name: search-ad
items.title: Search Ad
items.description: A search types out, the results show up, and the sponsored result is highlighted.

items.name: add-to-cart
items.title: Add to Cart
items.description: A click on the button sends the product flying into the cart; the badge bumps and the total climbs.

items.name: plan-toggle
items.title: Plan Toggle
items.description: The switch slides from monthly to yearly, the prices roll like an odometer and the discount badge pops in.

items.name: offer-countdown
items.title: Offer Countdown
items.description: A flip clock counts down to the real end of the offer, next to the real stock left.

items.name: review-card
items.title: Review Card
items.description: The stars light up one by one, the rating and the review count climb, and the reviews take turns.

items.name: map-pin-drop
items.title: Map Pin Drop
items.description: A pin drops on the map, bounces, and the address card slides up.

items.name: order-tracker
items.title: Order Tracker
items.description: Each stage checks off, the courier rides the route on the map and the time left counts down to delivered.

items.name: slot-booking
items.title: Slot Booking
items.description: A time slot fills with color and the booking is confirmed.

items.name: sales-funnel
items.title: Sales Funnel
items.description: A sales funnel as a sieve: people drop out at each stage and only the booked ones reach the bin.

items.name: roi-balance
items.title: ROI Balance
items.description: A bench balance weighs ad budget against the revenue it brings in; the pointer reads the return on ad spend.

items.name: page-speed-gauge
items.title: Page Speed Gauge
items.description: A stopwatch reads the page load time from its weight; the slower it loads, the more visitors leave before the door.

items.name: drone-button
items.title: Drone Button
items.description: A button carried by a quadcopter: it takes off when the pointer comes in, flies to it banking, kicks up dust and lands when the pointer leaves.

items.name: claw-button
items.title: Claw Machine
items.description: An arcade claw grabs the button and drops it into the prize chute on click.

items.name: rocket-button
items.title: Rocket Launch
items.description: A button between two boosters: countdown, liftoff with flames and smoke, and a parachute landing.

items.name: ufo-button
items.title: UFO Abduction
items.description: A flying saucer beams the button up when the pointer comes near and sets it down when it leaves.

items.name: magnet-button
items.title: Magnet
items.description: The pointer is a magnet: iron filings trace the field and the button leans toward it.

items.name: letters-button
items.title: Falling Letters
items.description: The label letters fall out on hover, pile up on the floor and spring back when the pointer leaves.

items.name: origami-button
items.title: Origami
items.description: Folds into a paper plane on click, flies a loop around the area and unfolds back into the button.
